notes.title: Boring failed successfully
notes.notes:
Hello there my borelings!


Almost a month after launch, Boring turned out to be too boring to be paid for—but still, it managed to raise enough money to buy myself a new 3D printer!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45499998/8a8662f43cf7cbdb268b5b1759e91570ddcc1e45.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45499998/a744afdf86f66a0806966cf802782834a954d6a0.jpg[/img][/url]

I'm printing so many little things every day—it's addictive!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45499998/60bcc86daeeb5917d60fcfdea2e1d57c89862e50.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45499998/d1b7f8950a6a272e2112b9e2ce3a22b674fd0a17.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]My favorite print so far: a gift box for my girlfriend. You made this possible![/i]

Now the not-so-good news: I don't think the game is going to sell a lot more, the sales are stalling, and there's no sign of change anytime soon.

Given the situation, I'm going to change the price and give it away for free.

Yes, you heard right—you can troll your friends by sending them this game to burn a couple of hours of their free time, FOR FREE. It's your chance to strike back for those boring 10-minute voice messages.

If your taste is too good to devaluate such a masterpiece, you can still support the game by purchasing the credits DLC:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468050/Borng__Credits/

The app will become free in a few days, as soon as Steam approves the change.


Stay bored!
